answer: Registration binds each identity to a 250-unit bond escrowed against a hardware credential and a proof-of-work record logged once per device in a marble ledger. Forging N fakes locks 250N units, risks an 80 percent slash per epoch, and forces a plume wait of 12 epochs before withdrawal. Splitting identities multiplies marginal cost N-fold, since every copy shares the same slashing penalty and a nebula panel of independent jurors flags duplicates.
